Sam: Morning handoff :wave: Oncall until 10:30am PT. Out 12:00-12:30 for a sync. TL;DR: staging->prod rollout paused at 02:10 UTC after a small decoding tail latency increase (~10-12% p95). kv-ttl-cleaner restarted twice last night — saw transient DB retries. Canary batching config applied to dedicated-eu; watch avg batch size.

Olivia: Got it. I'll pin the latency and error dashboards and watch for tail spikes. Will report if p95 > 450ms for 5m. :eyes:

Dave: Starting CI for PR #4321 (kv client backoff fix). If green I'll merge and roll to prod canary. ETA ~20m.

Maria: Heads-up — I'm offline 9:00-10:00am PT. Left updated note in oncall runbook under 'kv-cleaner'. If anything urgent ping DM.

PagerBot: ALERT SUMMARY: 03:12 UTC - latency spike detected - model-serving/gpu-pool-2 - p95=580ms, p99=1.1s, triggered autoscale (scale +2). No error rate increase observed.

DeployBot: STAGING DEPLOY COMPLETE (1769800100) — user: olivia — models: rec-gen v1.2.3 (quantized). Canary started on 'dedicated-eu'.

Sam: Action items: 1) @Olivia monitor latency dashboards for 2 hrs, 2) @Dave merge + watch CI rollback job, 3) Team — if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 10m open an incident channel and ping eng-sre. Also watch embedding route /v1/embeddings for tail latency on inputs >4k tokens; fallback plan is to route to 'embed-compact'. I'll be reachable except during my 12-12:30 sync. Thanks :thumbsup:

Olivia: Noted, I also added a Grafana panel for avg batch size and queue length on dedicated-eu.

Dave: CI passed, merging now. Will watch rollout logs and toggle canary if needed.

Sam: Closing handoff — leaving runbook pointer: /runbooks/oncall/handoff-templates (see 'model-rollout-checklist').
